clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope :   Requirements for forged brass gate, globe and check valves suitable for working temperatures up to 45ºC and non-shock maximum hydraulic working pressure of 2 MPa for water works purposes.

clauses.title: Nominal Sizes
clauses.text: 2. Nominal Sizes : 8(1/4), 10(3/8), 15(1/2), 20(3/ 4),25(1),32(1.1/4), 40(1.1/2) and 50(2) mm. Note : The nominal sizes shown in parantheses refer to the size of screw threads.

clauses.title: Materials
clauses.text: 3. Materials: See Table 1. TABLE 1 MATERIALS Component Material Body, bonnet, Forged brass cover stuffing box,disc, wedge and hinge Gland, gland nut, Forged brass ball, stem, stem or free cutting nut, hinge pin brass Handwheel Cast iron (see Note) Gland packing a) Hemp and jute b) Asbestos c)  Any other equally efficient packing material suitable for cold  water Spring (in case Phosphor check valve is bronze wire spring loaded) Note : Handwheels may also be made either in  steel, aluminium alloy, zinc alloy or of non- metallic  materials.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 4. Types a) Gate valves b) Globe valves SUMMARY OF IS  13114 : 1991 FORGED  BRASS GATE, GLOBE AND CHECK VALVES FOR  WATER WORKS PURPOSES c) Check valves: Swing type and  Lift type

clauses.title: Flow way area at
clauses.text: 6.1 Flow way area at any point shall be not less than that of a circle having an equivalent diameter as specified. However, globe and check valves with plug types discs and discs guided from below shall have a flow way area of not less than 85 percent of that specified for above.

clauses.title: For globe valves and
clauses.text: 6.2 For globe valves and check valves the direction of flow shall be with the upstream pressure under the disc.

clauses.title: Handwheel shall close the
clauses.text: 6.3 Handwheel shall close the valve by turning in clockwise direction, when facing the wheel.

clauses.title: Test Pressures
clauses.text: 7.1.1 Test Pressures : Shall show no visible leakage during the test under conditions as below: a) Shell Test : 1.5 × maximum working pressure of 2 MPa. b) Seat and Backseat Test : 1.1 × maximum working pressure of  2MPa.

clauses.title: Test Duration
clauses.text: 7.1.2. Test Duration : Minimum test duration shall be as follows a) Shell Test : 15 ses. b) Seat  and Backseat Test : 15 ses. There shall be no visible leakage during the tests.
